info.description: Showcase section for featured product categories and curated collections.

adminDisplayTitle.description: Internal name to identify this category/collection section in Strapi admin lists.

title.description: Main title heading of the category/collection section.

description.description: Short description text explaining the category selection.

badge.description: Top badge or label displayed above the section title (e.g. 'EXPLORE').

textLink.description: Label text for the 'View All' link (e.g. 'View All Categories' or 'See Collections').

linkUrl.description: Destination route for the 'View All' link (e.g. '/collections' or '/categories').

style.description: Grid layout style identifier (e.g. style-1, style-2).

headerStyle.description: Header title and badge typography style (e.g. style-1).

items.description: Dynamic list of Category or Collection cards to display in this grid.
